audit.whatIsWrong: Full layer names Hwei's CC ability 'Subject: Fear (CC Paints)' throughout (winCon, enemyWin, breakdown.cooldowns, feeding, loading, focus.text, a dosFull bullet, two report entries). Content layer separately invents 'Severing Bolt (EQ)', 'Molten Fissure', and 'Crushing Maw (EE)'.
audit.why: Hwei's real kit per champ-data/_kits/hwei.json is P Signature of the Visionary, Q Subject: Disaster, W Subject: Serenity, E Subject: Torment, R Spiraling Despair. None of 'Subject: Fear', 'Severing Bolt', 'Molten Fissure' or 'Crushing Maw' exist. The hardCC/slow flag that the text is describing belongs to Subject: Torment (E).
audit.corrected: Replaced fabricated names with the real ability, Subject: Torment (E), across the full layer and content spikes/wants; also named Subject: Serenity (W) where the text describes his zoning tool.

audit.why: Level chart agreement checked: content win[3-5]='Hwei' and full phases[3-5] would need the same check — see notes; early levels correctly rated as a skill matchup given both have poke and no early burst.
First-item and level-6 spikes correctly favor Hwei's mana-funded poke/zone kit; 2-item spike correctly favors Senna's soul-scaled range and global R.
